# ECMWF tropical-cyclone BUFR regression data

These are unmodified ECMWF files. The live captures contain IFS medium-range
forecasts from 21 November 2026 UTC. The 00 UTC hashes match
[weather issue #6](https://github.com/c933103/weather/issues/6). The shorter
cycles exercise the 144-hour filenames and variable track lengths.
Live data attribution goes to [ECMWF Open Data](https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/open-data).
The two Genevieve files are the table-35
[ECMWF technical-test samples](https://confluence.ecmwf.int/spaces/FCST/pages/212445612/Update+to+Tropical+Cyclone+tracks).
